svg.title: Qwen3.8 capacity on the native and tuned server configurations
svg.desc: Social card comparing the same 2K-input and 512-output workload on four Intel Arc Pro B70 GPUs: concurrency eleven on the native configuration, with 262K context, 48 recurrent-state entries, and a largest graph batch of eight; and concurrency twenty-two on the tuned configuration, with 12K context, 128 entries, and a largest graph batch of twenty-five. Both serve seven concurrent 8K-input 1K-output requests.
